en: An old black‑and‑white panoramic postcard showing a large hilltop fortress complex above a river. Massive stone ramparts and bastions step down the slope, with several substantial classical-style buildings on top, one with a small tower or belfry. Lower defensive walls run along the waterfront. The image is printed across two halves and is worn and creased along the middle; there is no visible printed caption on the front.
